key_insight: Ink3D bridges 3D asset generation with large-scale video generative models to produce highly detailed textures that traditional 3D generators often miss. The key idea is to borrow the rich visual priors of video models to sculpt 3D assets with complex, realistic surface appearance.
problem_solved: Existing 3D generative models can create plausible geometry but struggle with intricate, high-frequency textures because 3D training data is limited and lacks diverse surface appearance. This paper tackles the gap between strong visual generation and weak texture synthesis in 3D asset creation.
method: Uses a video generative model as a source of rich texture and appearance priors.
Integrates video-based visual modeling into a 3D generation pipeline to improve texture fidelity on 3D assets.
Targets the synthesis of objects with extremely complex textures while preserving 3D structure.
impact: This matters because it can significantly improve the realism and usability of AI-generated 3D assets for games, AR/VR, simulation, and digital content creation. For practitioners, it suggests a practical path to better texture generation by reusing large-scale video foundation models instead of relying only on scarce 3D data.

paper_title: Ink3D: Sculpting 3D Assets with Extremely Complex Textures via Video Generative Models
paper_authors: Yue Han, Chong Li, Zhening Liu, Cong Huang, Fang Deng
